observations: TextLayer is independent of TextOrigin and shaping identity. Placement/paint signature includes layer, preventing unchanged text/position from reusing outdated draw-stage batches.

Draw batch tuple carries page/layer/range; only adjacent glyphs with matching page and layer coalesce. Filtering preserves relative order within each layer while sharing the same instance buffer, atlas and generation lifetime. StagingVec charges actual tuple storage.

Console and later marking labels become Foreground; earlier scene/chrome/terminal text remain Workspace. Painter draws terminal background graphics and workspace glyphs before opaque Console geometry, foreground glyphs afterward, then existing terminal foreground graphics and menu/modal overlay stages. Existing terminal image-versus-text and menu-over-everything relations remain.
draw_console restores screen pipeline/bind group before binding screen vertices after text rendering; each glyph stage resets whole-target scissor and uses existing clipped glyph geometry.
